harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: His words «ولوطًا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied (muqaddar) "اذكر" (remember), and the implied clause is resumptive. «إذ»: badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from «لوطًا», and the clause «قال» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «وأنتم تبصرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «تأتون».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الرجال». «شهوة»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The clause «أئنكم لتأتون» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech, and the clause «بل أنتم قوم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The clause «فما كان» is resumptive; the interpreted maṣdar is the ism (subject) of kāna, and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). The clause «إنهم أناس» is resumptive, and the clause «يتطهرون» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: The clause «فأنجيناه» is resumptive, and «أهله» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the hāʾ in «أنجيناه». The clause «قدَّرناها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «امرأته».

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: «مطرًا»: stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «فساء مطر» is resumptive, and the specified one (al-makhṣūṣ) is omitted, i.e. "their rain".

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: «سلام»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); beginning with an indefinite noun is permitted because it is a supplication. «الذين»: naʿt (adjective) of «عباده». «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the Divine Name, i.e. "their associating". The clause «آلله خير» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: «أم» is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one, for digression (iḍrāb). «مَنْ»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "كَمَنْ لم يخلق" (like one who did not create). «ذات»: naʿt (adjective). The clause «ما كان لكم ...» is a naʿt of «حدائق», and the interpreted maṣdar «أن تُنْبتوا» is the ism (subject) of kāna. The clause «أإله مع الله» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «بل هم قوم»; the clause «يعدلون» is a naʿt.

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: «أم» is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one, for digression (iḍrāb). «مَنْ»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "كمن لم يجعل" (like one who did not make). «خلالها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object, and likewise «لها».

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: «مَنْ»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "كَمَنْ لا يجيب" (like one who does not answer). «إذا»: an adverb stripped of the conditional sense, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يجيب». «قليلا»: stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). «ما»: redundant (zāʾida). The clause «تذكَّرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: «مَنْ»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "كَمَنْ لا يهديكم" (like one who does not guide you). The second «مَنْ»: a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding «مَنْ». «بشرًا»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from الرياح. «بين»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بشرًا». «يدي»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with yāʾ because it is a dual. The clause «تعالى الله» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: «مَنْ»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "كَمَنْ لا يبدأ" (like one who does not originate). The second «مَنْ» is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding «مَنْ». «هاتوا»: an inflexible (jāmid) imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). The conditional clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: «مَنْ»: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause). «الغيب» is badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion), and the pronoun is implied (muqaddar), i.e. "their unseen". «إلا»: for restriction (ḥaṣr). «الله»: fāʿil (agent), i.e. none knows the unseen of those in the heavens and the earth except Allah. «أيان»: an interrogative noun, an adverb of time attached to «يبعثون». The clause «يبعثون» is the mafʿūl bihi of «يشعرون», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by «أيان» and carries the meaning of يعرفون (they know).

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: «بل»: a particle of digression (iḍrāb). The preposition «في الآخرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ادَّارك», and the clause after «بل» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: «إذا»: adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the meaning of the apodosis (jawāb), i.e. "shall we be brought out when we are…". «آباؤنا» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the pronoun «نا». The clause «أئنا لمخرجون» is explicative of the implied apodosis.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: «هذا»: second object. «نحن»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) in «وعدنا». «وآباؤنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the pronoun «نا». «إن» is negating, and «هذا أساطير» are mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). The clause «إن هذا إلا أساطير» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: The clause «كيف كان» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb of looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative and carries the meaning of knowing. «كيف» is an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of kāna.

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: His words «مما»: composed of the preposition «مِنْ» and the relative «ما»; the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ضَيْق».

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: «متى»: an interrogative noun, an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). «هذا»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and «الوعد» is a badal (substitute). The conditional clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: «عسى»: a complete (tāmm) past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is the interpreted maṣdar. The ism (subject) of «يكون» is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). «رَدِف» has been made to include the meaning of قَرُبَ (drew near), and the preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. «بعض»: fāʿil of «رَدِف». The clause «ردف لكم بعض» is the khabar (predicate) of «يكون».

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The clause «وإن ربك لذو» is resumptive, and the clause of correction (istidrāk) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one.

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: «ما»: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The negative clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «إن ربك ...». «ما» is negating and inoperative (muhmala). «غائبة»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida). The preposition «في السماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «غائبة». «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). The preposition «في كتاب» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of «غائبة», and «إلا» is for restriction.

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: «الذي»: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The preposition «فيه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يختلفون».

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: The clause «وإنه لهدى» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The clause «وهو العزيز» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يقضي».

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: «الدعاء»: second object. «إذا»: adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied apodosis (jawāb). «مُدْبرين»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw, and the clause «ولَّوا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: «ما» operates like laysa, and the bāʾ in its khabar (predicate) is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «هادي» in the sense of "turning away". «مَنْ»: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «وما أنت بهادي» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {إِنَّكَ لا تُسْمِعُ}. The clause «إن تسمع» is resumptive, and the clause «فهم مسلمون» is conjoined to the clause «يؤمن».

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. The preposition «من الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «دابة», and the clause «تكلمهم» is a naʿt of «دابة». The interpreted maṣdar «أن الناس كانوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition (the bāʾ).

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The wāw is resumptive. «يوم»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied (muqaddar) "اذكر" (remember). The preposition «من كل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «فوجا». The preposition «ممن» is a badal (substitute) from «من كل», attached to what it is attached to. The clause «فهم يُوزعون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «نحشر».

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya). «أمَّا» is composed of the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) «أم» and the interrogative (ما), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); «ذا» is a relative noun, its khabar (predicate). The clause «أم ماذا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: The clause «ووقع» is resumptive. «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «وقع». The clause «فهم لا ينطقون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one.

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: The interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of رأى. The second object of جعل is omitted, i.e. "dark" (مظلمًا). The interpreted maṣdar «ليسكنوا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جعلنا». «والنهار»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «الليل», and «مبصرًا» is a noun conjoined to the implied «مظلمًا». The preposition «لقوم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «لآيات», and the clause «يؤمنون» is a naʿt of «لقوم».

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: His words «ويوم»: the wāw is a conjunction; «يوم» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «يوم» in verse (83). The preposition «في الصور» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). «إلا» is for exception, and «مَنْ» is a relative noun, the excepted. The wāw in «وكل» is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause «وكل أتوه» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مَن في السماوات والأرض». «داخرين»: ḥāl from the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: The clause «وترى» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {يُنْفَخُ}. The clause «تحسبها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «ترى», and the clause «وهي تمر» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «جامدة». «صُنْعَ»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "صُنِعَتْ صُنْعَ" (it was made with the making of), and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: «مَنْ»: conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «وهم آمِنون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «جاء». The tanwīn in «إذٍ» is compensation for a clause, i.e. "on the day when he comes with the good deed".

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: The clause «فَكُبَّتْ» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with «قد» implied with it. The preposition «في النار» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كُبَّتْ». The clause «هل تجزون» is the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied "saying". «ما»: a relative noun, second object of «تجزون».

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن أعبد» is accusative by removal of the preposition (the bāʾ). «هذه»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «الذي»: naʿt (adjective) of «رب». The wāw in «وله» is parenthetical, and the clause «وله كل شيء» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items.

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and the clause «اهتدى» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «مَنْ».

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: The clause «سيريكم» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech, and the clause «وما ربك بغافل» is resumptive; the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) of «ما», which operates like laysa. The clause «وقل» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {إِنَّمَا أُمِرْتُ} in verse (91), and the preposition «عمَّا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) غافل.

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «هدى»: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. The preposition «للمؤمنين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بشرى».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «وهم يوقنون» is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause); the second «هم» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the first; the preposition «بالآخرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يوقنون».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The clause «فهم يعمهون» is conjoined to the clause «زيَّنَّا».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «أولئك الذين» is a second khabar (predicate) of inna. The clause «لهم سوء» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal relative noun. The second «هم» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the first, and the clause «وهم الأخسرون» is conjoined to the clause «لهم سوء».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «إنك لتلقى» is resumptive. «لدن» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تُلَقَّى». «عليم» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «حكيم».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «إذ»: an adverbial noun, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied اذكر (remember), and the clause «قال» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «سآتيكم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «نارًا». The two prepositional phrases «منها بخبر» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «آتيكم». The clause «أو آتيكم» is conjoined to the clause «سآتيكم». «قبس» is a badal (substitute) of «شهاب», and the clause «لعلكم تصطلون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «لما» is a particle of necessity upon necessity (wujūb li-wujūb). «أنْ» is explicative (tafsīriyya), and so is the clause with it. The preposition «في النار» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). The wāw in «وسبحان» is resumptive, and «سبحان» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); «رب» is a badal (substitute); and «العالمين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with yāʾ, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The hāʾ in «إنه» is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause is the response to the vocative, resumptive. The clause «أنا الله» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنه»; «العزيز الحكيم» are two naʿts (adjectives) of the Divine Name.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «وألق عصاك» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّهُ أَنَا اللَّهُ}. The conditional clause is resumptive. The clause «تهتز» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «رآها», and the clause «كأنها جان» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «تهتز». «مدبرا» is a ḥāl that emphasizes its governor. The clause «ولم يعقِّب» is conjoined to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) «ولَّى». The clause «يا موسى» is resumptive, and the clause «إني لا يخاف لدي المرسلون» is resumptive within the scope of the response to the vocative. «لديَّ» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, attached to the verb, and the second yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «إلا» is for disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ); «مَنْ» is a relative noun, the excepted (mustathnā). «حسنًا» is the object of «بدّل»; «بعد» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «بدَّل». The clause «فإني غفور» is resumptive; «رحيم» is a second khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «تخرج» is the apodosis of an implied condition. «بيضاء» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «تخرج», and the preposition «من غير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second ḥāl of the fāʿil of «تخرج». The preposition «في تسع» is attached to an implied verb, i.e. اذهب (go), and likewise «إلى فرعون». The clause «إنهم كانوا قومًا فاسقين» is a ḥāl of Pharaoh and his people.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «مبصرة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «آياتنا».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «وجحدوا» is conjoined to the clause {قَالُوا}; «ظُلْمًا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «فانظر» is resumptive; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of kāna; and the clause «كان» is an object of the [verb of] looking, suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, which carries the sense of knowing.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «ولقد آتينا» is resumptive; «علمًا» is the second object. The clause «وقالا» is conjoined to the clause «آتينا». «الذي» is a naʿt (adjective) of the Divine Name; the preposition «من عباده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «كثير».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «وورث سليمان» is conjoined to the clause {وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا}; «الناس» is an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the preposition «من كل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أوتينا». The clause «إن هذا لهو الفضل» is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa) between the two conjoined elements, and the clause «لهو الفضل» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «وحشر» is conjoined to the clause {وَقَالَ}; the preposition «من الجن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «جنوده»; the clause «فهم يوزعون» is conjoined to the clause «حُشر».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya). The yāʾ was dropped from «واد» in the script, following its pronunciation. «النمل» is an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). The clause «لا يحطمنكم» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; «لا» is prohibitive; it is a prohibition addressed to the troops in wording and to the ants in meaning. The clause «وهم لا يشعرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of Solomon and his troops.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «فتبسَّم» is resumptive; «ضاحكًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «تبسَّم», and the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تبسَّم». «رب» is a vocative (munādā) in a genitive construct, accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ. «أن» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), putting the verb in the subjunctive, and the interpreted maṣdar is the second object of «أوزعني». The prepositional phrase «وعلى والديَّ» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the yāʾ in «عليّ», with repetition of the preposition, and is attached to what that is attached to. «صالحًا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «ترضاه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «صالحًا». The preposition «في عبادك» is attached to the verb, and «الصالحين» is a naʿt.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «وتفقَّد» is resumptive. «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the clause «لا أرى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the yāʾ in «لي». «أم» is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, and the clause «كان» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «لأعذبنه» is the response to an implied oath. «عذابًا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the maṣdar being تعذيبًا.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The fāʾ in «فمكث» is resumptive. «غير» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), i.e. مكث وقتًا غير بعيد (he stayed a time not long). The preposition «بنبإ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «جئتك».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «تملكهم» is a naʿt (adjective), and the clause «وأوتيت» is conjoined to the clause «تملكهم». The nominal clause «ولها عرش» is conjoined to the verbal clause «أوتيت». The preposition «من كل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أوتيت».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «وجدتها» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; the verb means «لقي» (to find, meet) and so takes a single object. «وقومها» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the hāʾ in «وجدتها». The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الشمس». The clause «يسجدون» is a ḥāl of the hāʾ in «وجدتها» and what follows it. The clause «وزيَّن لهم الشيطان» is conjoined to the clause «يسجدون», and the clause «فهم لا يهتدون» is conjoined to the clause «صدَّهم».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: «أن» puts the verb in the subjunctive, and the interpreted maṣdar is a badal (substitute) of {أَعْمَالَهُمْ}; the implied sense is: وزيَّن لهم الشيطان عدم السجود لله (and Satan made attractive to them not prostrating to Allah). The preposition «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الخبء».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: «الله» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause of transcendence is the khabar (predicate); «ربُّ» is a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «صدقت» is the object of «ننظر», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative that carries the sense of knowing. «أم» is a conjunction, and the clause «كنت» is conjoined to the clause «صدقت».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «اذهب» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. «هذا» is a demonstrative, a naʿt (adjective) interpreted as a derived word, i.e. المشار إليه (the one pointed to). The hāʾ in «ألقه» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); it was given sukūn for lightness, and this is a dialect usage. «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); «ذا» is a relative noun, its khabar (predicate); and the clause «ماذا يرجعون» is a mafʿūl bihi of the [verb of] looking, suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «إني ألقي» is the response to the vocative, resumptive; «الملأ» is an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition).

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «إنه من سليمان» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the clause «وإنه بسم ...» is conjoined to the resumptive clause. The prepositional phrase «بسم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. ابتدائي كائن (my beginning is [with]). The clause «ابتدائي باسم الله» is the khabar of «إنَّ», and «الرحمن الرحيم» are two naʿts (adjectives) of the Divine Name.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «أن» puts the verb in the subjunctive. «مسلمين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «ائتوني». The interpreted maṣdar from «أنْ» and what follows it is a badal (substitute) of {كِتَابٌ}, as though it were said: أُلقي إليَّ: ألا تعلُوا عليّ (there has been delivered to me: that you not exalt yourselves against me).

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The clause «ما كنت» is resumptive; «أمرًا» is the object of «قاطعة». «تشهدون» is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by a necessarily implied «أن», the sign of its subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the implied (muqaddar) yāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: «أولو»: a khabar (predicate), nominative with wāw, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. The clause «والأمر إليك» is conjoined to the clause «نحن أولو», and the clause «فانظري» is conjoined to the clause «الأمر إليك». «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); «ذا» is a relative noun, the khabar; and the clause «ماذا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the [verb of] looking, suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, which carries the sense of knowing.

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The conditional clause and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of inna; «أذلة» is the second object. The wāw in «وكذلك» is resumptive; the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), [followed by] a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «يفعلون» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. The implied sense is: يفعلون فِعْلا مثل ذلك الفعل (they do a doing like that doing).

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The clause «وإني مرسلة» is conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying). The two prepositional phrases «إليهم بهدية» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مرسلة». As for «بم»: the bāʾ is a preposition, and «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to «يرجع»; the alif of the interrogative «ما» was dropped because it is in the genitive. «فناظرة» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «مرسلة». The clause «يرجع» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle «ناظرة», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative that carries the sense of knowing.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, as is the clause «فما آتاني الله خير». «ما» is a relative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «خير» is its khabar (predicate). «آتاني» is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied fatḥa because of impossibility [of pronouncing it]; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the implied (muqaddar) yāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «ممَّا» is composed of the preposition «مِنْ» and the relative «ما», and the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير». The preposition «بهديتكم» is attached to «تفرحون», and the clause «بل أنتم تفرحون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The clause «ارجع» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. The fāʾ is a conjunction, and the lām occurs in the response to the oath; the oath clause and its response are conjoined to the clause «ارجع». The preposition «بجنود» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «نأتينَّهم», and the clause «لا قِبل لهم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جنود». The preposition «بها» is attached to the [notion of] settledness (istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached. «أذلة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ, and the clause «وهم صاغرون» is a ḥāl of the hāʾ in «نخرجنَّهم».

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «أيكم»: an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يأتيني» is the khabar (predicate). «قبل» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يأتيني», and the interpreted maṣdar «أن يأتوني» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «مسلمين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The preposition «من الجن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عفريت». «آتيك» is an imperfect verb with its object. The interpreted maṣdar «أن تقوم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «وإني عليه لقوي» is conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); «أمين» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «عنده» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject). The preposition «من الكتاب» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «علم». «قبل» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to «آتيك». The conditional clause is resumptive. «مستقرًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the general [verb of] being has been mentioned together with the quasi-clause because the speech is built upon it from the outset. «عنده» is an adverb of place attached to «مستقرًا». The lām in «ليبلوني» is causal, and the genitive maṣdar is attached to the [notion of] settledness (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached. The clause «أم أكفر» is conjoined to the clause «أشكر», and the clause «أأشكر» is an object of the verb of testing, which is suspended (muʿallaq) from governing by the interrogative, in the position of the accusative. Its suspension is permissible because testing is examination, and examination carries the sense of knowing, being a path to it; so it carries the sense of knowing in a certain respect. The wāw in «ومَنْ» is resumptive; «مَنْ» is conditional, a mubtadaʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: «ننظر»: jussive (majzūm), because it is the apodosis of an implied condition. The clause «أتهتدي» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb of looking, suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, which carries the sense of knowing. The clause «تكون» is conjoined to the clause «تهتدي».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is the pronoun of the maṣdar, i.e. قيل هو, meaning the saying. The hamza in «أهكذا» is interrogative, the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), the kāf is a preposition, and «ذا» is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «عرشك». «العلم» is the second object. The clause «وأوتينا» is resumptive, and the clause «وكنا مسلمين» is conjoined to the resumptive clause.

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «وصدَّها» is resumptive; «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent); the preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما». The clause «إنها كانت» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The preposition «لها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قيل», and it is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «قيل». The preposition «من قوارير» is attached to a second naʿt (adjective) of «صَرح». The adverb «مع» is attached to the verb «أسلمت», as is «لله». «رب» is a badal (substitute) of the Divine Name.

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «ولقد أرسلنا» is resumptive; «صالحًا» is a badal (substitute); «أنْ» is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause with it is explicative. The fāʾ is a conjunction and «إذا» is the «إذا» of surprise (fujāʾiyya); the clause «هم فريقان» is conjoined to the response to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: «يا قوم»: a vocative (munādā) in a genitive construct, accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ. «لِمَ»: the lām is a preposition, and «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تستعجلون»; its alif was dropped for lightness because it was preceded by a preposition. «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), and the clause «تستغفرون» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. The clause «لعلكم ترحمون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: «معك»: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). The clause «بل أنتم قوم» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The clause «وكان» is resumptive; the clause «يفسدون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «تسعة».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: «أهله»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the hāʾ. The clause «وإنَّا لصادقون» is conjoined to the clause «ما شهدنا».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «وهم لا يشعرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun «نا».

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «فانظر» is resumptive; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of kāna; the clause «كيف كان» is an object of the [verb of] looking, suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, which carries the sense of knowing. The interpreted maṣdar «أنَّا دمَّرْناهم» is a badal (substitute) of «عاقبة». «قومهم» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the hāʾ in «دمَّرناهم»; «أجمعين» is a tawkīd (emphasis), accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The clause «فتلك بيوتهم» is conjoined to the clause {كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ}; «خاوية» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «بيوتهم». The bāʾ is a preposition, «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خاوية». The preposition «لقوم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «آية».

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The clause «وأنجينا» is conjoined to the clause «تلك بيوتهم».
